id: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
en: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
it: \rCiao, benvenuto al Centro Pokémon.

id: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
it: \rQui rimettiamo in forze i tuoi Pokémon stanchi.

id: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi far riposare i tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
en: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
it: \rBene, prendo i tuoi Pokémon per qualche secondo.

id: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
en: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon potrebbero aver contratto il Pokérus.

id: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
en: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
it: \rSi sa poco del Pokérus, se non che si tratta di forme di vita microscopiche che si attaccano ai Pokémon.

id: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
it: \rSi dice che i Pokémon infetti crescano eccezionalmente bene.

id: \rThank you for waiting.
en: \rThank you for waiting.
it: \rGrazie per l'attesa.

id: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono di nuovo in piena forma.

id: \rWe hope to see you again!
en: \rWe hope to see you again!
it: \rTorna a trovarci!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
en: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati e sono in perfetta salute.

id: \rWe hope you excel!
en: \rWe hope you excel!
it: \rSpero che tu abbia successo!

id: There is no battle recorded.
en: There is no battle recorded.
it: Non è stata registrata nessuna lotta.

id: \rWelcome to the Battle Tower.
en: \rWelcome to the Battle Tower.
it: \rBenvenuto alla Torre Lotta.

id: \rWould you like to participate in a single battle?
en: \rWould you like to participate in a single battle?
it: \rVuoi partecipare a una lotta singola?

id: \rDo you want to take the Level 50 challenge, or the Open Level challenge?
en: \rDo you want to take the Level 50 challenge, or the Open Level challenge?
it: \rVuoi affrontare la sfida Livello 50 o la sfida Livello Libero?

id: \rSorry, you can't participate. You need three different Pokémon to enter.
en: \rSorry, you can't participate.  You need three different Pokémon to enter.
it: \rMi spiace, non puoi partecipare.  Per iscriverti servono tre Pokémon diversi.

id: \rThey must be of a different species and hold different items.
en: \rThey must be of a different species and hold different items.
it: \rDevono essere di specie diverse e tenere strumenti diversi.

id: \rCertain exotic species, as well as eggs, are ineligible.
en: \rCertain exotic species, as well as eggs, are ineligible.
it: \rAlcune specie esotiche, così come le uova, non sono ammesse.

id: \rPlease choose the three Pokémon that will enter.
en: \rPlease choose the three Pokémon that will enter.
it: \rScegli i tre Pokémon che parteciperanno.

id: \rPlease come this way.
en: \rPlease come this way.
it: \rDa questa parte, prego.

id: \rCome back another time.
en: \rCome back another time.
it: \rTorna un'altra volta.

id: \rCongratulations for winning.
en: \rCongratulations for winning.
it: \rCongratulazioni per la vittoria.

id: \rPlease take this prize.
en: \rPlease take this prize.
it: \rTi prego, accetta questo premio.

id: \rYou have no room for it. At least you won, though.
en: \rYou have no room for it.  At least you won, though.
it: \rNon hai spazio per tenerlo.  Almeno hai vinto, però.

id: \rWould you like to record your last battle?
en: \rWould you like to record your last battle?
it: \rVuoi registrare la tua ultima lotta?

id: \se[expfull]The battle was recorded.
en: \se[expfull]The battle was recorded.
it: \se[expfull]La lotta è stata registrata.

id: Your results will be recorded.\wtnp[15]
en: Your results will be recorded.\wtnp[15]
it: I tuoi risultati verranno registrati.\wtnp[15]

id: \rThanks for playing.
en: \rThanks for playing.
it: \rGrazie per aver partecipato.

id: \rWe've been waiting for you. Please come this way.
en: \rWe've been waiting for you.  Please come this way.
it: \rTi stavamo aspettando.  Da questa parte, prego.

id: \rExcuse me, but you didn't save before finishing your challenge last time.
en: \rExcuse me, but you didn't save before finishing your challenge last time.
it: \rScusa, ma l'ultima volta non hai salvato prima di terminare la sfida.

id: \rSorry, but your challenge has been canceled.
en: \rSorry, but your challenge has been canceled.
it: \rMi spiace, ma la tua sfida è stata annullata.

id: \rWould you like to participate in a double battle?
en: \rWould you like to participate in a double battle?
it: \rVuoi partecipare a una lotta in doppio?
